title: Oven Roasted Croatian Chickpeas Salad
description: A citrusy and crisp Croatian dish featuring roasted chickpeas, perfect for a post-workout snack, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the chickpeas and remove any loose skins.
In a bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
Spread the chickpeas on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
While the chickpeas are roasting, render the lardons in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the chickpeas from the oven and let cool slightly.
To serve, place the roasted chickpeas on a slate tile vessel and top with crispy lardons.
